purpose: Construct the exact source-ordered eight-dimension role bundle while preserving opaque role payloads and unresolved cross-domain mappings without asserting sufficiency.

required.statement: Require exact source ordinals one through eight, each once, with one opaque role per ordinal.
Return labels in exact source order: Message, Principles, Values, Virtues, Capacities, Competencies, Practice, Lived Experience.
Preserve exactly TLC-UT-THEOREMS-001, 005, and 007 through 012, each once and attached to its supplied role.

forbidden.statement: Do not use input mapping iteration order as output order.
Do not merge role records, drop unresolved mappings, or invent missing role-to-unresolved associations.
Do not define scientific classifications, assert sufficiency, verify PROOF-THEOREMS-003, or return a truth value.

deferred.statement: Scientific definitions and cross-domain mapping semantics for all eight unresolved identifiers remain external.
Internal validation sequence and low-level runtime representation remain implementation-defined.

operations.purpose: Validate exact ordinals and unresolved mappings and construct the exact source-ordered opaque role sequence.

inputs.name: dimension_roles
inputs.semantic_role: source ordinal to opaque dimension-role mapping

inputs.name: cross_domain_mappings
inputs.semantic_role: opaque role to exact unresolved mapping identifier

preconditions.statement: Exactly the source ordinals one through eight are present and unique.
Every role has exactly one supplied unresolved mapping and the unresolved population is exact.

postconditions.statement: The output has eight entries in exact source ordinal and label order, independent of input map iteration.
Every opaque role and supplied unresolved association is unchanged and no sufficiency assertion exists.

invariants.statement: Ordinal and label jointly determine record identity; equal opaque payloads are never merged.
The exact eight unresolved identifiers remain attached once each.

steps: construct records by ascending source ordinal
publish exact ordered bundle or stable error

partial_order.after: publish exact ordered bundle or stable error
publish exact ordered bundle or stable error
publish exact ordered bundle or stable error

partial_order.before: construct records by ascending source ordinal
partial_order.after: publish exact ordered bundle or stable error

prescription_basis: Output construction by source ordinal is observable and normative; validation internals and storage remain open.

error_contract.condition: A required source ordinal has no role.
A source ordinal occurs more than once.
A role lacks its required unresolved mapping or an unresolved mapping would be dropped.

implementation_modes.statement: Expose exact source-order construction and unresolved mapping preservation.
Do not define unresolved classifications, assert sufficiency, or verify a proof.
Input and internal mapping representations are free; output source order is not.

global_invariants.statement: The exact ordinal-label sequence remains 1:Message through 8:Lived Experience.
Every supplied opaque role and exact unresolved identifier survives without definition, merging, or loss.

notes: Exact source ordering is normative; scientific sufficiency is not asserted.
